title: ONE TYPE SYSTEM FOR THE MENUS
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): the menus and text still look bad, make it look like a triple-A game. Second step of the UI redesign (ui3). The loudest amateur tell on the screenshots was caps spaced far apart (up to .42em), in a mix of families and in sizes down to 10.5px. The menus now have one type system: condensed industrial caps for titles, tabs, buttons, labels and chips, and a plain grotesque for anything you read. Letter spacing never goes past .12em and shrinks as the size grows, and nothing in a menu is smaller than 13px (before the screen scale). The new faces (Barlow Condensed and Barlow) are added once he says yes to downloading them; until then the menus use Bahnschrift, the condensed DIN-like face built into Windows. 100 stylesheet lines changed. His own words are untouched.
now: Menu text now uses one condensed caps face for titles and buttons and a plain face for reading, with tight letter spacing and nothing under 13px.
